children: US flooring retailer's Q3 sales rose 3% but slightly missed analyst expectations
Diluted EPS for Q3 rose 15% year-over-year
Company returned $91.4 mln to shareholders via share repurchases
Company expects fiscal 2026 net sales of $4.77 bln to $4.84 bln
Floor & Decor forecasts 2026 comparable store sales to decline 3.5% to 2.0%
Company sees 2026 diluted EPS of $2.19 to $2.29
CHALLENGING DEMAND - Co said 1.4% decline in comparable store sales reflected a challenging demand environment
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Operating margin rose 30 basis points to 6.4% as co maintained profitability despite lower comparable sales
STORE EXPANSION - Co opened one new warehouse store during the qtr, ending with 282 warehouse stores
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 15 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the home improvement products & services retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc. is $54.00, about 13.6% above its October 28 closing price of $47.55
The stock recently traded at 22 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 29 three months ago
